'''Ankor Dail''' is a city-fortress in [[Shienar]]. It is in the southeast of the nation near the easterly source of the [[River Erinin]].

==History==
The [[Aiel]] fought a battle near Ankor Dail. [[Masema Dagar]] fought them there and, as a result, did not like [[Rand al'Thor]] when they first met.{{ref/book|2|10}}

==Activities==
Ankor Dail sends men to join the other [[Shienaran]]s at [[Tarwin's Gap]] to fight the [[Trolloc]] army.{{ref/book|1|48}} A [[sniffer]] lives in Ankor Dail.{{ref/book|2|9}}
